{{Quote|I'm really quite pleasant to have around, you know. Many fems have thought so. Many.|The Devaronian hits on Leia Organa|<ref name="Shadows of the Empire (novel)">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Devaronian''' once tried to pick up [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] while in a sleazy [[Unidentified Mos Eisley cantina|cantina]] in the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. After several attempts to dismiss him, the Princess finally succeeded in doing so by brandishing a [[DH-17 blaster pistol/Legends|blaster]].
